screening_runs.scope: Bounded official reader-route follow-up for existing RSL records 01000275094 (Blagorazumova), 01004299840 (Isagulyan dissertation), and 01003269330 (paired author abstract).
methods: Fetched the three exact official Search RSL record pages and inspected displayed bibliographic description, access badge, reader link, and MARC 856 where present.

Followed official RSL /ru/view and dlib/viewer routes. Queried official viewer document-info API for each rsl-prefixed record ID; for Isagulyan dissertation also checked the stated access level and page/content download boundary.

Submitted one bounded read-only Picodex task covering these three IDs and official routes only. Its claims were cross-checked against RSL pages, dlib wrappers, and viewer API responses before recording.
incremental_findings: Blagorazumova RSL record states full open access, but has no MARC 856 or functional reader URL in the checked HTML; /ru/view returned HTTP 400 and viewer API returned HTTP 404. No text or methods were obtained.

Isagulyan dissertation 01004299840 has an official PDF/reader route, but viewer API reports accessLevel restricted, isAvailable=false, download disabled and full text only in RSL/virtual reading rooms; page-content endpoints returned HTTP 403. No methods inspected.

Isagulyan author abstract 01003269330 is also labeled open-access in the RSL catalogue, but has no MARC 856/reader URL; /ru/view returned HTTP 400 and viewer API returned HTTP 404. No text or methods were obtained.
The RSL catalogue links author abstract 01003269330 to dissertation 01004299840; this is one dissertation with its paired abstract, not two independent candidate works.
screening_runs.coverage_limit: This pass establishes reader-route/access metadata only. The mismatch between open-access badges and unavailable viewer IDs does not establish that copies do not exist. No method-level or absence-of-analogue conclusion is made; further authorized access or a surfaced official full-text route is required.
